simple.meaning: חָפֵר (châphêr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to blush ; figuratively, to be ashamed , disappointed ; causatively, to shame , reproach.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 17 times across Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and 1 more, beginning at Job 6:20. Its contexts include family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָפֵר (H2659).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָפֵר (châphêr) / H2659 is traced through Job 6:20, Psalms 34:6, Psalms 35:4, Psalms 35:26 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to blush ; figuratively, to be ashamed , disappointed ; causatively, to shame , reproach
definitions.usage: be ashamed, be confounded, be brought to confusion (unto shame), come (be put to) shame, bring reproach.
definitions.full: H2659. chapher II. [ חָפֵר ] verb be abashed, ashamed ( חֲפַר ᵑ7 Prov 13:5 , מַחְמְּרָנָא one causing shame 19:26 ; Syriac , especially Aph`el be ashamed, put to shame ; Arabic be bashful , shy, bashful ; Ethiopic be ashamed, blush ) — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular חָֽפְרָה Jer 50:12 ; וְחָֽפְרָה consecutive Isa 24:23 ; וְחָפֵ֑רָה Jer 15:9 ; חָֽפְרוּ Psa 71:24 ; וְחָֽפְרוּ consecutive Micah 3:7 ; Imperfect יַחְמְּרוּ Psa 35:4 4 t.; יֶחְמָּ֑רוּ 34:6 ; וַיֶּחְמָּ֑רוּ Job 6:20 ; תַּחְמְּרוּ Isa 1:29 ; — be abashed, ashamed , said of face Psa 34:6 (avoided by looking to ׳י ); elsewhere always || בּוֺשׁ , of enemies of righteousness 71:24 ; 35:4 ; 35:26 ; 40:15 = 70:3 ; 83:18 ; of idolaters Isa 1:29 ; diviners Micah 3:7 ; of distressed Jerusalem Jer 15:9 ; so of Babylon 50:12 ; of moon Isaiah 24:33; be put to shame (disappointment), of caravans looking for water Job 6:20 . Hiph`il Perfect הֶחְמִּיר Isa 33:9 ; Imperfect יַחְמִּיר Prov 13:5 ; תַּחְמִּ֫ירִי Isa 54:4 ; Participle מַחְמִּיר Prov 19:26 ; — display shame , figurative of Lebanon Isa 33:9 (|| קָמַ֑ל 'dried up' Che); of Israel 54:4 (|| בּוֺשׁ Qal); of an unfilial son, cause shame Prov 19:26 (|| מֵבִישׁ ); compare 13:5 of wicked (|| יבאישׁ : see באשׁ Hiph`il above).
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as 2658 through the idea of detection );

occurrences.englishText: They were distressed because they were confident.
This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him,
Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor.
Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity.
Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
Let them be turned because of their shame
My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long,
that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh,
He who robs his father and drives away his mother,
For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired,
Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion, and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.
“Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed.
She who has borne seven languishes.
your mother will be utterly disappointed.
